keywords.def: The condition of the atmosphere over a short period of time.
The average of all weather conditions of an area over a long period, about 30 years.

en.text: Weather is the condition of the atmosphere over a short time: today's rain, wind or temperature. Climate is the average of weather over a long time, about 30 years. Climate tells us what is usual; weather can be different from it.

am.text: የአየር ሁኔታ የከባቢ አየር የአጭር ጊዜ ሁኔታ ነው። የአየር ንብረት የረጅም ጊዜ (30 ዓመት ገደማ) አማካይ ነው።

screens.title: Usual or today?
screens.ask: "Addis Ababa is usually cool, with heavy rain from June to September." Is this weather or climate?
screens.after: Climate: it describes what is usual over many years, not one day.

screens.title: Weather and climate
paras: Weather is the condition of the atmosphere over a short period of time.
It includes daily changes in precipitation, air pressure, temperature and wind.
Climate is the average of all weather conditions of an area over a long period, about 30 years.
Climate tells us what is usually expected. The weather on a day can be different.
